kitDescription: Brid is a Water AR Burst-III Attacker whose Skill 1 re-arms every 30 rounds she fires and grants herself a 10-second ATK ▲18.52% buff, which at AR cadence refreshes near-continuously once armed. Her Skill 2 is a single-target 211.2%-of-final-ATK skill hit that fires on a fixed 10-second internal cooldown against the highest-DEF enemy. Her burst deals 1440% of final ATK as burst damage to the highest-DEF enemy, plus a second 1440% additional-damage instance gated on a Max-HP condition. On the partless scope-lock boss the targeting selectors are trivially the boss, and the burst cast lands before Full Burst opens so it never takes the +50%. In the control rotation she casts 5 bursts over 180s.

burst Max-HP rider: 'credits exactly ONE 1440% instance' — the duplicate-flatDamage ratio patch reads 1.50 under the driver's two-instance model instead of the blind's pinned 2.00; this IS the adjudicated divergence, not an independent fault

The S5 red is a RECON_ERROR-class artifact of the blind event-shape assumption, not a modeling fault.

burst.formulaCheck: no HP-pool primitive exists in v1, so EITHER reading reduces to a posture (always-true vs inert), not a measured mechanic; the effect itself (function damage, crit-eligible, cast-instant FB-exempt) is correctly routed under the driver's encoding
burst.explanation: ADJUDICATION — driver's encoding STANDS, by binding adjudicated precedent: soline (gauntlet 2026-08-03, GO faithfulness 1.0, judge kimi-code/k3 — this judge family) carries the IDENTICAL wording and its record ruled caster-HP/always-true FAITHFUL and explicitly NAMED the boss-HP reading as the nearest-wrong model ('fires the 924 at most once, silently deletes ~70% of burst damage — excluded'), with both blind families converging there. Roster consistency requires identical wording to encode identically; reversing here on the same evidence base would fork the roster. The blind-side grammar counter-argument is real but was available to the soline judge and did not carry. The decision is fully documented (caveat + note + test pin B8/B9 discriminating 2-vs-1 and 2×1440-vs-merged-2880), so even under the alternative reading this is a DOCUMENTED posture, never a silent drop. The ⚑ same-model residual and its popup recipe carry forward for owner spot-check.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: all five kit lines are FAITHFUL, four by direct triple convergence (driver + S6 structure + S2b spec) and the fifth — the burst Max-HP rider — by binding adjudicated precedent (soline 2026-08-03, identical wording, caster-HP/always-true ruled FAITHFUL with the boss-HP reading explicitly excluded as nearest-wrong). The two S5 reds decompose exactly as the soline run's did: one is the convention dispute itself (the payload of this adjudication, not an independent fault), the other a schema-literal artifact (durationShots null vs undefined) whose intent the driver model satisfies — a RECON_ERROR in the blind test, not a finding. S6's ⚑ on the S2 cadence is superseded by the datamined skillCooldownsSec skill2=10 the packet omitted from its brief. Discrimination holds throughout: B3 (counter 30 vs 60), B5 (interval vs hitCount, exact wall-clock pin), B7 (fbMajorApplied never true), B8/B9 (2 instances vs 1, and two 1440s vs merged 2880), and the S5 duplicate-patch ratio test all fail under their named counterfactuals. Fire-rate check passes: S1 re-arms every ~2.5s of firing with exact application-count pinning, S2 fires at t=10..170 wall-clock, burst lands 2 instances × 5 casts. SAME-MODEL RESIDUAL for owner spot-check (carried from soline, ⚑): the caster-HP reading of the Max-HP gate is same-model consensus with no popup measurement — recipe: a brid focus recording where she takes damage once, watching whether the second 1440% popup stops; if the enemy-HP reading is ever confirmed, remove the second burst block (tests pin the current posture and will go red to signal the change).
